rows.label: Bureaus per credit pull
rows.note: A tri-merge report: one score from each bureau, for each borrower.

rows.label: Credit pulls per funded loan
rows.note: Not in these files: applications that never fund and re-pulls count. Test it against the Check line.

rows.label: FICO price per score
rows.note: FICO's 2026 price to tri-merge resellers on the per-score model. For 2027, FICO's Oct 23, 2026 release holds its $10 wholesale price for lenders enrolled in its Preferred Program, where it buys Classic FICO and FICO 10T together; on Nov 4 FICO said it will not disclose its other prices.

rows.label: FICO fee per borrower per score on a funded loan
rows.note: None on the $10 model, which FICO holds for 2027 for lenders enrolled in its Preferred Program. Its performance model is $4.95 per score plus $33 here; on Nov 4, 2026 FICO said that model still awaits GSE certification.

rows.label: VantageScore price per score
rows.note: Equifax about $1 and TransUnion 99 cents, both through 2028.

rows.label: FICO mortgage origination revenue in its latest reported quarter ($m)
rows.note: Quarter to Sep 30, 2026, from FICO's slides. The call gives it as 58% of $413.8m of Scores revenue. Up 72% on the year on price, with volumes down high single digits; below the quarter before's $282m on lower volume and more home equity at a lower price.

rows.label: FICO fiscal 2026 revenue ($m)
rows.note: Year to Sep 30, 2026. FICO gave no fiscal 2027 guidance, citing its move to lender-by-lender mortgage pricing for 2027 and uncertain mortgage-market conditions.

rows.label: FICO total revenue in its latest reported quarter ($m)
